description: This file defines a module for validating Python code generated by an LLM before execution in Pyodide. It includes patterns to detect unsafe constructs such as dangerous imports, builtins, and modules, and provides a function to validate code safety.

classes.name: PythonCodeValidationResult
classes.description: Interface representing the result of Python code validation, indicating if the code is valid and optionally providing a reason.

methods.name: validatePythonCodeForDataFrame
methods.description: Function that checks a given Python code string against forbidden patterns to ensure safety for DataFrame operations in pandas.
